held.title: New uses of `Kysely`, `DB` and `AssetRepository` come with no added imports.
held.body: The change declares `let db: Kysely<DB>` and calls `ctx.get(AssetRepository)`, but neither hunk adds an import. The line counts (+36 -1) match only the lines shown, so no import was changed anywhere in the file. If the file did not already import `Kysely` from 'kysely', `DB` from the schema, and `AssetRepository`, the spec fails type-checking or fails at runtime with a ReferenceError for `AssetRepository`. I could not see the file's existing imports. If any are missing, add them.

held.title: Changing `order` one row at a time can hit a uniqueness constraint on (workflowId, order).
held.body: `createWorkflow` most likely gives the action order 0 and the filter order 1. The loop then updates each row on its own. If the action row comes back first, setting it to 1 while the filter still holds 1 leaves two steps with the same order for a moment. If `workflow_step` has a unique index on (workflowId, order), that update throws and the test fails before it checks the fix. I could not see the schema. To avoid the clash, first move the rows to non-overlapping values (for example, set the action to 99), or update both rows in one statement with a CASE expression.
